I am a year 2 undergraduate of Department of Computer Science, University of Warwick. My major is Computer Systems Engineering (aka Electronics and Computer Engineering, ECE). My personal tutor is Dr. Hongkai Wen and I am also directed by Dr. Ligang He. My research interests/goals (so far) include Agent Communication, AI-enabled security attack and defense drills, Application of AI/ML in Security Protection and Financial Technology.
I am one of this year’s Tencent Global Campus Ambassadors (Ref Code: N466QYQAUW).

Email: Huiheng.Li@warwick.ac.uk or huihengli66@outlook.com
Feel Free to contact me about anything!
